A structure-only TOML scanner with no dependency finds table headers and key paths, and it knows strings, arrays and inline tables so it never reads their contents as structure. It reads `[mcp_servers.<name>]` from a trusted project's `.codex/config.toml`, the same trust its hooks need (binary, SPEC §Codex host). The operator's own bytes stay identical, which keeps init → uninit --purge byte-clean.
